phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Plant both boots with soft knees; carry the blade diagonally above the shoulder, keeping both wrists aligned with the same hilt.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Draw shoulder and hips back slightly, lifting the blade without dragging its tip through cape, helmet or the supporting forearm.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Drive one short diagonal cut from the torso; the second hand follows the hilt instead of sliding independently along the blade. Anchor release to the existing shot event. A restrained frost accent may identify the confirmed slowing hit; the sweep creates no extra contact damage.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Finish outside the knee line, decelerate visibly, then recover through a compact arc into the guarded diagonal without a second strike.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Hold a compact airborne display posture with talons beneath the body and the two wings framing the throat and head.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Raise the wing roots, narrow the chest slightly and aim the beak toward the selected target without moving the defensive position.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Give one firm downstroke and short forward head emphasis; a small torso pitch supplies intent while preserving the bird silhouette. Anchor the primary release to the existing shot event. Additional lightning appears only on its actual conditional outcome with existing target relationships.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Use the next upstroke to restore the broad feather shape and gently retract the talons without creating another release gesture.

eventMarkers.authority: Existing CombatManager shot event, not an animation timer
eventMarkers.instruction: Prepare the proposed pose before this event; it cannot delay, create or retarget a shot.
Feedback follows the actual outcome; a local animation marker does not apply damage.
Preserve actual chain targets and conditional outcome; no extra body attack for each hop.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: a compact wing lift prepares one firm downstroke, with a softer restoring upstroke. Anchor ordinary release to the current shot event and preserve its cadence. Conditional lightning feedback follows the actual proc rather than adding another wing-driven attack.

contactLimits.approvedAnalysisConstraints: Keep two feet, two wings and one beak. No dragon jaw, extra legs, human casting hands or automatic multi-chain flourish.
additionalRules: Footprint and actual planted feet remain fixed unless a separately reviewed contact-aware motion is implemented.
Keep grasp and complete held weapon in the same transform island; blend attached anatomical/cuff vertices toward stable shoulders.
Keep rider pelvis, saddle, stirrups, reins and supported mount contacts coherent. No generic whole-mount bob substitutes for articulation.
Native rest snapshots are restored by reset(); prototype motion does not certify full collision-free or manifold posed surfaces.
contactLimits.pending: Actual finite geometry and exact reset are checked. Independent posed triangle collision, full attachment/contact clearance, production anatomy and human motion approval remain pending.

models.secondaryMotion: Outer feathers lag wing roots, tail feathers counter torso pitch and the gold beak stays rigid relative to the bird skull.
models.approvalFocus: Approve feather-led power and the conditional lightning distinction, with a clean talon silhouette and no ambiguity about the creature’s anatomy.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Let the string settle, then rewind and present the next bolt within the existing cadence; this is reload staging, not a new ammunition rule.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Open the palm in a concise benediction as the torso rises gently and the right hand steadies the tall staff. Ordinary holy release anchors to the existing shot event. Support and detection continue independently and must not appear to expire when the gesture finishes.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Settle the carriage on all wheels with bowl, stone and axle connected and the loaded throwing arm clear of the chassis braces.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Tension or lower the arm slightly around its actual axle while keeping the stone seated and the frame firmly supported.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Accelerate the arm forward as one lever; the bowl carries the stone until the clearly defined release rather than letting it float beforehand. Stone departure anchors to the existing shot event. Conditional stun is shown only at its confirmed impact, never as a second physical arm strike.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Dampen the lever against its stop, return through a winch-like reset and present the next stone within the existing rapid cadence.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: emphasize a short tension stage, fast rigid lever swing and damped stop followed by reset. The current rapid shot cadence is unchanged. Stone departure anchors to the existing event; reload presentation compresses as needed without altering travel time or conditional stun.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Stand centrally with the staff upright, left hand open and all four spirits clear of crown, face and physical staff grip.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Gather the open hand inward and let the spirits tighten their arrangement while the staff crown inclines toward the selected targets.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Extend the palm in a brief royal command and emphasize the staff, avoiding both an archer’s draw and mechanical recoil. Anchor the coordinated three-target release to the existing shot-event group. Four visible spirits need not each fire; decoration must never create a fourth attack.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Restore the composed open-handed guard while each spirit resumes its distinct position without crossing through the crown or sleeve.

eventMarkers.authority: Existing CombatManager shot event, not an animation timer

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: use a very economical royal hand command and staff emphasis, with spirit reactions continuing independently afterward. Preserve the current rapid three-target shot group. All four spirits need not perform a release; their decorative timing must not create additional attacks.

contactLimits.approvedAnalysisConstraints: No bow, quiver, siege carriage, new summons or elemental debuffs. Physical damage and true strike remain unchanged despite magical visual presentation.
additionalRules: Footprint and actual planted feet remain fixed unless a separately reviewed contact-aware motion is implemented.
Keep grasp and complete held weapon in the same transform island; blend attached anatomical/cuff vertices toward stable shoulders.
Keep rider pelvis, saddle, stirrups, reins and supported mount contacts coherent. No generic whole-mount bob substitutes for articulation.
Native rest snapshots are restored by reset(); prototype motion does not certify full collision-free or manifold posed surfaces.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Follow through with fingers and elbow, then retrieve the next arrow economically without a large torso spin or second release gesture.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Keep a narrow grounded stance, dark bow forward, torn cloth behind the string and the belt sword sheathed.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Draw the elbow back with a deliberate head tilt, loading shoulder tension instead of gathering an imagined staff spell.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Use a decisive full draw and slight forward chest emphasis, preserving coherent angular bow limbs, visible string and glove contact. Anchor ordinary release to the existing shot event. Fire splash appears only after its actual landed-hit proc and is not a second fire arrow.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Hold a brief hard follow-through, then re-nock close to the body while the bow returns to the same guarded line.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Dampen the heavier recoil and reset string and bolt within the current cadence, preserving the continuous central firing path.

models.ownershipRule: Each actual runtime primitive belongs to at most one channel. Held props and grasp receive one common transform; connected arm/cuff vertices fade to stationary shoulder. Localized body fields retain explicitly weighted foot/root regions at rest. Fixed-node names alone do not certify contact.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Plant heavy feet apart, balance the stone torso and carry the armed forearm clear of the opposite fist and chest.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Rotate the chest and raise the ballista forearm into aim while the other shoulder and knees provide a small connected brace.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Present the forearm weapon squarely and give one short release recoil instead of making the whole construct throw or detach its fist. Anchor ordinary fire to the existing shot event. A confirmed gaze may hold the head steadily toward its sector but cannot guarantee petrification.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Lower the armed forearm slightly and settle the heavy torso; the unarmed fist remains a counterweight rather than a second damaging action.

eventMarkers.authority: Existing CombatManager shot event, not an animation timer
eventMarkers.instruction: Prepare the proposed pose before this event; it cannot delay, create or retarget a shot.
Feedback follows the actual outcome; a local animation marker does not apply damage.
Use actual sustained gaze state and facing-time/petrification conditions; do not guarantee the proc.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: make the weapon-arm raise weighty but compact, with crisp forearm release and a settling stone torso. Keep the existing shot cadence. A confirmed Stone Gaze uses a separate sustained attention state, not a delayed ordinary shot or guaranteed petrification cue.

contactLimits.approvedAnalysisConstraints: No detachable fist, new melee slam, damaging gaze beam or extra stun. Respect facing-time conditions and the integrated mechanism’s own firing axis.
additionalRules: Footprint and actual planted feet remain fixed unless a separately reviewed contact-aware motion is implemented.
Keep grasp and complete held weapon in the same transform island; blend attached anatomical/cuff vertices toward stable shoulders.
Keep rider pelvis, saddle, stirrups, reins and supported mount contacts coherent. No generic whole-mount bob substitutes for articulation.
Native rest snapshots are restored by reset(); prototype motion does not certify full collision-free or manifold posed surfaces.
contactLimits.pending: Actual finite geometry and exact reset are checked. Independent posed triangle collision, full attachment/contact clearance, production anatomy and human motion approval remain pending.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Seat the dwarf between wing roots, feet supported and left hand on reins, with one visible bomb in the right hand.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Brace the rider through the saddle and draw the throwing arm back while the griffin makes a restrained balancing wing-root adjustment.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Toss overhand clear of beak and feathers, preserving left-hand rein control and stable rider hips throughout the throw. Anchor release to the existing shot event. Conditional stun follows the actual landed-hit result; both debuff auras continue independently rather than being recast.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Return the arm toward an attached magazine, restoring readiness without sliding the dwarf out of the saddle or adding another bomb.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: use a short saddle brace, brisk rider throw and compact magazine return. Bomb release anchors to the existing shot event. contactLimits.approvedAnalysisConstraints: No griffin claw strike, dive bomb, extra mount projectile or floating rider. Keep four legs, exactly two wings and real saddle contacts.
additionalRules: Footprint and actual planted feet remain fixed unless a separately reviewed contact-aware motion is implemented.
Keep grasp and complete held weapon in the same transform island; blend attached anatomical/cuff vertices toward stable shoulders.
Keep rider pelvis, saddle, stirrups, reins and supported mount contacts coherent. No generic whole-mount bob substitutes for articulation.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Support the closed book against the left forearm, staff upright and robe hem settled around a stable balanced stance.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Lift the chin and gather the staff shoulder inward while the book remains supported instead of opening, floating or changing hands.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Present the staff briefly and use a calm chest-led chant gesture, retaining a clear sun emblem and readable book cover. Anchor ordinary holy release to the existing shot event. Passive chants and protection remain independent of how widely the book arm moves.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Restore the vertical staff and settle the head without lowering the book through the gown or adding another blessing strike.

eventMarkers.authority: Existing CombatManager shot event, not an animation timer
eventMarkers.instruction: Prepare the proposed pose before this event; it cannot delay, create or retarget a shot.

Keep presentation independent of personal attack; gestures do not recast, suspend or expand the effect.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: use a concise staff presentation and calm head emphasis, preserving a stable supported book throughout. Anchor the personal holy release to the current shot event. Chants, resistance and detection remain continuous; repeated fast attacks should not require large ceremonial arm swings.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Keep the crozier upright beside the mitre and left palm open above its cuff, with feet stable beneath the continuous gown.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Lift the palm toward the chest and incline the head while the right shoulder stabilizes the tall staff and its open ring.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Extend one measured benediction from elbow and wrist; a slight chest rise distinguishes the action from idle without a large body sway. Anchor ordinary holy release to the existing shot event. The support aura continues independently and should not pulse as if it were manually recast.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Return the hand to its resting height while preserving staff verticality and the gown’s uninterrupted silhouette around the body.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: use a measured but small blessing gesture, gentle return and almost stationary crozier. Its formal weight must not postpone the existing holy shot. phaseKeyPoses.name: Ready contact envelope
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Carry the ring staff upright right-handed with the left empty; keep all three crystals clear of crown, face, hair and gown.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Prepared pose before scheduled combat event
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Incline the ring toward the target and gather the empty hand, preparing only when the existing scheduler permits rather than delaying a due attack.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Attack gesture and existing release anchor
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Open the palm and give a concise staff emphasis while preserving poised expression and stable gown silhouette, without a heavy warrior lunge. Anchor ordinary release to the existing shot event and proc accents to actual outcomes. On Melancholy, suppress that release and enter a quiet lowered posture.

phaseKeyPoses.name: Contact-preserving follow-through and return
phaseKeyPoses.keyPose: Recover to guard after a real shot. During Melancholy, hold a subdued pause and return only when the combat state actually ends.

eventMarkers.authority: Existing CombatManager shot event, not an animation timer
eventMarkers.instruction: Prepare the proposed pose before this event; it cannot delay, create or retarget a shot.
Feedback follows the actual outcome; a local animation marker does not apply damage.
Preserve actual chain targets and conditional outcome; no extra body attack for each hop.
After the actual landed-hit proc, retain current fork targets and chance independently of chain.
Cancel the preview release when actual Melancholy starts. Remain subdued until actual combat state ends; no animation-duration cure.

models.proposedTiming: Proposed timing: use a short poised ring-staff preparation and clear ordinary release at the existing shot event. Chain and fork feedback follow confirmed outcomes independently. Melancholy cancels that attack before release; hold a subdued pose until the actual combat state ends, not a fixed animation timer.

contactLimits.approvedAnalysisConstraints: No extra crystals, crown redesign, healing or automatic lightning. A canceled attack has no projectile, damage or forced normal recovery; resistance cannot cure Melancholy.
additionalRules: Footprint and actual planted feet remain fixed unless a separately reviewed contact-aware motion is implemented.
Keep grasp and complete held weapon in the same transform island; blend attached anatomical/cuff vertices toward stable shoulders.
Keep rider pelvis, saddle, stirrups, reins and supported mount contacts coherent. No generic whole-mount bob substitutes for articulation.
Native rest snapshots are restored by reset(); prototype motion does not certify full collision-free or manifold posed surfaces.
contactLimits.pending: Actual finite geometry and exact reset are checked. Independent posed triangle collision, full attachment/contact clearance, production anatomy and human motion approval remain pending.

implementedPrototypeBounds.contactRule: Complete actual staff and grasp share a field, three two-material crystals each form one pivot island. Externally selected Melancholy cancels the cast preview; no automatic proc.

models.secondaryMotion: The three crystals may slow and the head lower during the confirmed pause; crown, hair and gown retain restrained independent delayed motion.
models.approvalFocus: Approve elegant casting and distinct proc feedback, especially the immediately readable canceled-attack pause and a return controlled by actual combat state rather than animation duration.
models.remainingImplementationWork: Review visible motion amplitude, silhouette and posed contacts in the local viewer; refine production articulation and collision clearance, then integrate with the existing authoritative gameplay events. All listed runtime channels are implemented; this is not a claim of final production animation approval.

No random proc, lightning damage, actual game event or automatic state duration is implemented.
